title: The Book of Habakkuk Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Habakkuk — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.decoded: This is the message that the prophet Habakkuk received from God.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
verses.decoded: Lord, how long will I keep crying for help without you listening? I keep shouting about violence, but you don’t save us!

verses.kjv: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
verses.decoded: Why do you allow me to see wrongdoing and witness trouble? Everywhere I look, there is destruction and violence; people are stirring up conflict and fighting.

verses.kjv: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the law is ignored and justice is never carried out. The wicked surround the righteous, so justice is twisted and unfair decisions are made.

verses.kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
verses.decoded: Look at the nations around you and pay attention; be amazed because I am going to do something in your lifetime that you won’t believe even if someone tells you about it.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
verses.decoded: I am raising up the Babylonians, a cruel and quick-tempered nation, who will sweep across the land and take over homes that don’t belong to them.

verses.kjv: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
verses.decoded: They are terrifying and fearsome; their own power and authority come from within themselves.

verses.kjv: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
verses.decoded: Their horses are faster than leopards and fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their riders spread out widely and come from far away, swooping down like eagles eager to catch their prey.

verses.kjv: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
verses.decoded: They come to do violence; their faces are like the east wind, and they will collect captives as easily as sand on the shore.

verses.kjv: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
verses.decoded: They will mock kings and make princes their laughingstock. They will laugh at every fortress, tearing it down and taking it.

verses.kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
verses.decoded: But then the leader’s attitude will change; he will move on and act arrogantly, crediting his success to his own god.

verses.kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
verses.decoded: Lord, aren’t you eternal, my Holy God? We won’t die. You have appointed these people to bring judgment and set them up to correct us.

verses.kjv: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
verses.decoded: You are too pure to look at evil and cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do you watch those who act deceitfully and stay silent while the wicked destroy people who are more righteous?

verses.kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.decoded: Do you make people like fish in the sea or creatures that crawl around with no leader over them?

verses.kjv: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.decoded: They catch all of them with hooks, trap them in nets, and gather them in fishing nets; that’s why they celebrate and are happy.

verses.kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
verses.decoded: So they offer sacrifices to their fishing nets and burn incense to their fishing traps, because these bring them a good share and plenty of food.

verses.kjv: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
verses.decoded: Will they stop catching fish and stop killing nations continuously because of this?

verses.kjv: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.decoded: I will stand guard and position myself on the lookout tower to see what the Lord will say to me and how I should respond when I am corrected.

verses.kjv: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.decoded: The Lord answered me, saying, 'Write down the vision clearly on tablets so that anyone who reads it can understand it quickly.'

verses.kjv: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.decoded: The vision is meant for a specific future time; when it happens, it will be true. Even if it seems delayed, be patient because it will definitely come and will not be late.

verses.kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
verses.decoded: Look, the proud person is not right within themselves, but the righteous will live by trusting in God.

verses.kjv: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.decoded: Yes, because he sins through drunkenness, he is proud and restless, always wanting more like the grave that never fills. He gathers many nations and people to himself.

verses.kjv: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.decoded: Won't all these people tell stories and mocking sayings against him, saying, 'Woe to the one who gains what doesn’t belong to him! How long will this go on? Woe to the one who burdens himself with worthless things!'

verses.kjv: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.decoded: Won't those you’ve wronged suddenly attack you and trouble you, and you will become their prey?

verses.kjv: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: Because you have plundered many nations, the survivors will plunder you in return, because of the bloodshed and violence in the land, the city, and among its people.

verses.kjv: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.decoded: Woe to the one who greedily desires evil gains for his own house, trying to build his home on high to escape danger!

verses.kjv: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.decoded: You have brought shame on your family by destroying many people and have sinned against yourself.

verses.kjv: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.decoded: Even the stones in the wall and the beams in the woodwork will cry out and accuse you.

verses.kjv: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.decoded: Woe to the one who builds a city through violence and establishes it by wrongdoing!

verses.kjv: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.decoded: Look, isn’t it the Lord Almighty who makes people work hard in vain and grow tired for nothing?

verses.kjv: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.decoded: The whole earth will be filled with the knowledge of the Lord’s glory, just as the seas are covered with water.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.decoded: Woe to the one who gives their neighbor alcohol to get them drunk so you can take advantage of them!

verses.kjv: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
verses.decoded: You are full of shame instead of honor; drink from the cup of God's wrath, and let your pride be exposed. The cup held by the Lord will be given to you, bringing disgrace instead of glory.

verses.kjv: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: The destruction caused by the violence in Lebanon will overwhelm you, along with the fearsome beasts that were frightened by human bloodshed and the violence throughout the land, the city, and all its people.

verses.kjv: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.decoded: What good is a carved idol that its maker has shaped? A molten image that lies and deceives—its creator trusts in it to make silent idols.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.decoded: Woe to those who command a piece of wood to wake up or a silent stone to speak and teach! Look, these idols are covered with gold and silver, but they have no life or breath inside.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.decoded: But the Lord is present in His holy temple; let the whole earth be silent and respectful before Him.

verses.kjv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
verses.decoded: This is a prayer by the prophet Habakkuk, set to a type of passionate or emotional song called Shigionoth.

verses.kjv: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.decoded: Lord, I have heard what you said and it frightened me. Please bring your work back to life during these difficult times; in your anger, please remember to show mercy.

verses.kjv: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.decoded: God came from the south, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory filled the skies, and the whole earth praised him.

verses.kjv: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
verses.decoded: His brightness was like shining light; beams of power seemed to come from his hand, and his strength was hidden but evident.

verses.kjv: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
verses.decoded: Plague and destructive forces went ahead of him, like burning coals at his feet.

verses.kjv: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
verses.decoded: He stood and surveyed the earth; he looked and broke apart the nations. The eternal mountains were scattered, and the everlasting hills bowed down. His ways last forever.

verses.kjv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.decoded: I saw the tents of Cushan (Ethiopia) in trouble, and the shelters of Midian shook with fear.

verses.kjv: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
verses.decoded: Was the Lord angry with the rivers? Was your anger directed at the seas, that you rode on your horses and chariots of salvation?

verses.kjv: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.decoded: You prepared your bow fully, fulfilling the promises made to the tribes, your word is sure. You split the earth with rivers.

verses.kjv: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
verses.decoded: The mountains saw you and shook; the floodwaters rushed by; the deep waters roared and lifted up their hands.

verses.kjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
verses.decoded: The sun and moon stopped in their places; they moved at the light of your arrows and the shining of your spear.

verses.kjv: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
verses.decoded: You marched across the land in anger, crushing the nations with your fury.

verses.kjv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
verses.decoded: You came to save your people, your anointed one; you struck down the leader of the wicked, exposing him from head to neck. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.decoded: You struck down the leaders of their villages; they rushed out like a storm to attack me, rejoicing as if to secretly destroy the poor.

verses.kjv: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
verses.decoded: You rode your horses through the sea, through the vast waters.

verses.kjv: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
verses.decoded: When I heard this, my stomach shook and my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones, and I trembled inside, hoping to find peace on the day of trouble. When he comes against the people, he will attack them with his army.

verses.kjv: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.decoded: Even if the fig tree doesn’t blossom and there is no fruit on the vines; even if the olive trees produce nothing and the fields give no food; even if the sheep are taken away from the pen and there are no cattle in the stalls,

verses.kjv: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.decoded: I will still rejoice in the LORD; I will be joyful in the God who saves me.

verses.kjv: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.decoded: The LORD God is my strength; he will make my feet as sure as a deer’s, enabling me to walk safely on high places. (This is a song for the leader, to be played on stringed instruments.)
